==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will attempt to maintain this on themselves and as many [[spellcaster]] party members as possible, in and out of combat.

== Notes ==
* Unlike some other [[doublecast skill]]s, the effects are not doubled when you target yourself.
* This can increase a [[minion]]'s health, presumably by {{gr|1|3}} times its energy gain, which is visible to the caster.
* The concise description is more ambiguous than the complete description regarding maximum health increase.

{{anomaly|Changing your maximum energy lower than what it was when this was cast on you, will lower your health bonus accordingly to your new energy, however swapping back to higher energy will not bring it back up and it will remain at the lower amount, even if recast on you at higher energy before its duration ends.}}
